slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;好消息？
辰南疑惑的望着姜玉婵，等待下文。
“这一次的谣言，从林家传出，父亲已经下令，给予林家惩罚。”
“另外，萧家一脉故意在药田上做文章，也已经被严重警告。”
“至于林家，林天南之死和林梦瑶被打，都是他们咎由自取，父亲已经下令严惩。”
“这一次参与此事的林家、萧家与林家三脉，皆受了惩罚，短时间内，他们应该不会再兴风作浪。”
姜玉婵笑吟吟的说道。
辰南终究还是太年轻了。
而且辰家一脉刚刚重开，根基不稳，却又树大招风。
紫薇圣主不得不亲自出手，镇压三脉，免得辰家一脉这株幼苗，还未成长便夭折了。
“替我谢谢姜叔！”
辰南心中一暖。
“辰南哥哥，你也不能大意。”
“如今谣言四起，诸脉虎视眈眈，不是一时半会儿就能消除影响的。”
“另外三脉虽然暂时被镇压，但恩怨并未消除，他们明面上不敢再轻举妄动，但谁也无法保证他们是否会暗地里耍阴招。”
“所以你一定要小心谨慎，保护好自己！”
姜玉婵眸若星辰，柔声提醒。
“小婵，谢谢你和姜叔对我的帮助。”
“至于这些魑魅魍魉，我会小心提防，但也不会畏惧。”
“不经历风雨，如何能见彩虹？”
辰南的脸上洋溢着自信。
“辰南哥哥，你的实力好像又突破了，难不成你身上的天道枷锁能够解开了？”
姜玉婵微微吸了口气，这才问出心中的疑惑。
其他人都以为是紫薇圣主出手，替辰南解开了天道解锁。
但姜玉婵知道并不是。
所以她很好奇，辰南有办法解开自身的天道枷锁，重新修炼？
“侥幸解开了两道枷锁！”
辰南笑了笑，对姜玉婵并未隐瞒。
虽然她猜到了，但从辰南的口中得到确认，还是让姜玉婵吃惊不已。
荒古圣体的名气，一部分是荒古时代的肉身无敌，另一部分就是天降枷锁，圣体变废体。
三千年来，也曾出过其他荒古圣体，但却根本无人能够打破诅咒，解开天道枷锁。
而辰南却依靠自己的力量，解开了两道枷锁。
这简直是不可思议！

Chen Nan looked at Jiang Yuchan in confusion, waiting for the next step.
"This time, rumors spread from the Lin family. My father has ordered the Lin family to be punished."
"In addition, the Xiao family has been severely warned for deliberately making a fuss about the medicinal field."
"As for the Lin family, the death of Lin Tiannan and the beating of Lin Mengyao are all their own fault. My father has ordered severe punishment."
"This time, the Lin family, the Xiao family and the Lin family who participated in this matter have all been punished. They should not cause trouble again in a short period of time."
Jiang Yuchan said with a smile.
Chen Nan is still too young after all.
Moreover, the Chen family lineage has just been reopened, and its foundation is unstable, but it is still strong and attracts the wind.
Holy Lord Ziwei had to personally take action to suppress the three lineages, lest the seedling of the Chen family lineage die before it could grow.
"Thank you Uncle Jiang for me!"
Chen Nan felt warm in his heart.
"Brother Chennan, you can't be careless."
"Nowadays, rumors are spreading everywhere, and all kinds of people are watching with eager eyes. The influence cannot be eliminated in a short while."
"Although the other three lines have been temporarily suppressed, their grievances have not been eliminated. They dare not act rashly on the surface, but no one can guarantee whether they will play dirty tricks secretly."
"So you must be careful and protect yourself!"
Jiang Yuchan's eyes were like stars and she reminded her softly.
"Xiaochan, thank you and Uncle Jiang for helping me."
"As for these monsters and monsters, I will be careful, but I will not be afraid."
“How can you see a rainbow without experiencing wind and rain?”
Chen Nan's face was filled with confidence.
"Brother Chen Nan, your strength seems to have broken through again. Is it possible that the shackles of heaven on you can be released?"
Jiang Yuchan took a breath and then asked the doubts in her heart.
Everyone else thought it was Holy Master Ziwei who took action and unlocked the way of heaven for Chen Nan.
But Jiang Yuchan knew that was not the case.
So she was very curious, could Chen Nan free himself from the shackles of heaven and practice again?
"Fortunately, two shackles were released!"
Chen Nan smiled and did not hide it from Jiang Yuchan.
Although she had guessed it, Jiang Yuchan was still surprised to get confirmation from Chen Nan.
The fame of the Ancient Holy Body is partly due to its physical invincibility in the ancient era, and the other part is the shackles sent down from heaven, which turns the Holy Body into a waste body.
In the past three thousand years, other ancient holy bodies have appeared, but no one has been able to break the curse and release the shackles of heaven.
But Chen Nan relied on his own strength to unlock the two shackles.
This is incredible!
